placeholder.title: On its way
placeholder.body: This part of TimeCheck is being built. Today's events are ready now.

auth.signInLead: Welcome back. Sign in to see today's gatherings.
auth.noAccount: Accounts are made by your cell leader or church admin.
auth.invalidCredentials: That email and password don't match. Try again, or reset your password.
auth.rateLimited: Too many tries. Wait a minute, then try again.
auth.unexpected: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
auth.offline: You're offline. Connect to the internet to sign in.
auth.forgotLead: Enter the email on your account and we'll send a reset link.
auth.linkSentBody: If {email} has a TimeCheck account, a reset link is on its way. It expires in 1 hour.
auth.resetLead: Use at least 12 characters with letters and numbers.
auth.resetDoneBody: You're signed in with your new password.
auth.resetExpired: This reset link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
auth.weakPassword: Choose a stronger password, one that's harder to guess.
auth.expiredLinkBody: Reset links work once and last 1 hour. Request a new one below.
auth.changeLead: Pick one only you know: at least 12 characters with letters and numbers.
auth.mfaLead: Admin accounts need a code from an authenticator app, like Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator.
auth.mfaScan: Scan this with your authenticator app.
auth.mfaQrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
auth.mfaSecret: Or enter this key by hand
auth.mfaEnter: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.mfaCodeInvalid: Enter the 6 digits from your app.
auth.mfaWrong: That code didn't work. Codes change every 30 seconds; try the newest one.
auth.consentLead: Before you start, here's how your church uses your information.
auth.consentPoint1: We keep your name, contact details, birthday and attendance so your leaders can care for you.
auth.consentPoint2: Only your cell leader and church admins see your details. Birthdays and phone numbers are encrypted.
auth.consentPoint3: You can see and correct your profile at any time, and ask an admin to remove your account.
auth.consentPoint4: We never sell your information or use it for ads.
auth.consentLaw: This follows the Philippine Data Privacy Act of 2012.
auth.consentStale: The privacy notice was just updated. Reload the page to read the new one.

errors.passwordNeedsMix: Include at least one letter and one number.

errors.guardianConsentRequired: A parent or guardian has to agree first.
errors.groupNameTaken: Another group already has this name.
errors.leaderInvalid: Choose someone with the Leader role. Promote them first if needed.
errors.linkInvalid: Use a link that starts with https://
errors.endBeforeStart: End after it starts, or tick “Ends the next day”.

invites.privacy: Only you, your leader and admins see guest details. They're removed 90 days after the event unless the guest joins.
